desc: Instantiate a target on top of a LightNVM enabled device
u: nvme-lnvm-create - Instantiate a target on top of a LightNVM enabled device

Instantiate a target on top of a LightNVM enabled device. This exposes the physical for the user to use.

The target name is the name of which the media is exposed as in /dev/<targetname>

The target type is the target to be instantiated. Typically pblk or rrpc.

LUN begin and end defines the range of LUNs to use for a target instantiation.

<dl><dt data-o="">--device-name=<DEVICE>, -d <DEVICE></dt><dd>Device name to initialize.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--target-name=<TARGET>, -n <TARGET></dt><dd>Target name of the device to initialize. For example: target0.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--target-type=<TARGETTYPE>, -t <TARGETTYPE></dt><dd>Target type of the device to use. For example: pblk</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--lun-begin <NUM>, -b <NUM></dt><dd>Begin LUN id offset to use for target</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--lun-end <NUM>, -e <NUM></dt><dd>End LUN id offset to use for target</dd></dl>

•Initialize nvme0n1 with pblk target with 64 LUNs.
# nvme lnvm-create -d nvme0n1 -t pblk -n target0 -b 0 -e 63
